info.title: SpeechNexus administration API
info.description:
Deployment-scoped administration and observation API. These routes do not
establish a user identity, role, or tenant boundary. A deployment may expose
them on a separate listener or route allowlist, but the API itself must not
pretend that hiding a navigation entry is authorization.

Model binding revisions and runtime instances are separate resources.
Capacity manifest and qualification report documents stay in the release
evidence chain; the admin API exposes only their recorded identity and
locator. No response exposes private artifact paths, engine endpoints,
credentials, or arbitrary container control.

A workspace is not a user, tenant, ACL, or privacy boundary. Creation is

get.summary: List logical resource pools and current reservations
List model binding families and their current revisions

get.description:
Returns recorded instance generations ordered by `instance_id`
ascending, then by `generation` ascending. That pair is the instance
table's primary key, so the ordering is total: a page boundary is a
position in the key frontier, never an offset into an unordered scan.
`cursor` resumes strictly after the position it records and is bound to
the `host_node_id` and `state` filters that produced it; reusing it
under another filter returns 400 `invalid_model_instance_cursor`.
`limit` defaults to 50 and must be between 1 and 100. Any other limit, an
unknown query parameter, or a filter value outside the declared schema
returns 400 `invalid_model_instance_request`. `has_more` is false and
`next_cursor` is null on the last page and for an empty collection.

Each row reports the facts recorded for that generation in the runtime
instance store and its binding revision: identity, binding revision,
pool, generation, configuration digest, observed state, readiness time,
stop time and quarantine reason. Facts that store does not record are
omitted instead of synthesized; in particular a row never carries loaded
artifact digests, the process start time, a heartbeat time or instance
stop evidence.

Returns one recorded instance generation with the same recorded facts a
list row carries. The lookup has two layers, and the two misses share
the 404 status but not the code: `error.code` is
`model_instance_unknown` when no generation of `instance_id` is
recorded, and `model_instance_generation_unknown` when the instance is
recorded but the requested `generation` is not. Malformed path values
return 400 `invalid_model_instance_request`; an unreadable store returns
503 instead of reporting absence.

get.summary: List model binding lifecycle audit events
get.description:
Returns the append-only audit events recorded for model binding
lifecycle changes. The audit table stores only `kind=binding` events;
profile, workspace, and policy changes currently produce no audit
events, so this endpoint cannot return them. The `action` filter
matches one recorded action exactly; a value no recorded event carries
returns an empty page instead of an error.

Rows are ordered by `occurred_at` descending, then by `id` descending.
That pair is a total order because `id` is unique, so a page boundary
never depends on unspecified database order. `cursor` resumes strictly
after the position it records and is bound to the `action` filter that
produced it: a cursor from another filter, or one this operation did
not issue, returns 400 `invalid_audit_cursor`. `limit` defaults to 50
and must be between 1 and 100; any other value returns 400
`invalid_audit_request`. `has_more` is false and `next_cursor` is null
on the last page and for an empty collection.

XRequestId.description: Validated client request ID or a server-generated correlation ID.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

ResourcePool.description:
A logical capability pool. The same pool may contain ready instances on
several host nodes; `node_ids` lists the nodes that currently contribute
to the aggregate counts.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Logical capability resource pool identifier. Pools may span multiple host nodes.

latest_revision.description: Highest immutable revision in this binding family.

current_revision.description: Active revision used for new work; null when the family has never been published or its current revision was retired.

publication_status.description: Publication status of latest_revision. A newer draft can coexist with a different current_revision.

External_shared_runtime_states_schema_js.description: Observed lifecycle state. Only `stopped` proves that the process or container and its reserved resources are gone; `failed` and `quarantined` may still retain capacity.

External_model_instance_schema_json_Root.title: ModelRuntimeInstance
External_model_instance_schema_json_Root.description: Dynamic runtime instance fact for a node-scoped engine process or container. This schema is internal to admin, scheduler, deployment controller, and execution gateway; it is not a public model or voice DTO. A new generation is required after every restart. Every observed fact is reported only when its producer actually recorded it; a producer that does not record a fact omits the member instead of synthesizing a value. `stop_evidence` is the instance-level physical stop document and never the execution-level lease or submit-intent evidence.

binding_revision_id.description: Must equal ModelBindingRevision.revision_id for the referenced binding.

generation.description: Monotonic per-instance generation allocated by the deployment controller. Stale generations must be fenced.

ReadinessFacts.description: Readiness facts for this generation. `accepting_new_work` is always declared because it follows directly from `state`; the remaining members are present only when the producer observed and recorded them.

loaded_artifact_digests.description: Digests of the exact artifacts this generation loaded, when the producer records the loaded set. An empty array records that nothing was loaded; an absent member records that the loaded set was not recorded.

warmed_capabilities.description: Capabilities this generation warmed, when the producer records the warmed set.

ready_at.description: Time this generation began accepting new work, when recorded; null means the transition was not recorded.

StopEvidence.description: Instance-level physical stop evidence: the process or container exited, its reserved resources were released, and the observation was verified. Lease and submit-intent cleanup evidence is execution-level, carries its own kinds, and is not reported here.

ObservedFacts.description: Observed timing and termination facts for this generation. Every member is optional: a producer that did not record a fact omits it rather than inventing one.

started_at.description: Recorded process or container start time. A producer that only tracks readiness and stop transitions does not record it.

last_heartbeat_at.description: Recorded most recent heartbeat. A producer without a heartbeat channel does not record it.

stopped_at.description: Time the physical stop was verified, when recorded; null means the instance was not observed stopped.

stop_evidence.description: Instance-level physical stop evidence, when the producer recorded it.

External_model_instance_schema_json_Read.description: Readiness facts for this generation. `accepting_new_work` is always declared because it follows directly from `state`; the remaining members are present only when the producer observed and recorded them.

loaded_artifact_digests.description: Digests of the exact artifacts this generation loaded, when the producer records the loaded set. An empty array records that nothing was loaded; an absent member records that the loaded set was not recorded.

warmed_capabilities.description: Capabilities this generation warmed, when the producer records the warmed set.

ready_at.description: Time this generation began accepting new work, when recorded; null means the transition was not recorded.

External_model_instance_schema_json_Obse.description: Observed timing and termination facts for this generation. Every member is optional: a producer that did not record a fact omits it rather than inventing one.

started_at.description: Recorded process or container start time. A producer that only tracks readiness and stop transitions does not record it.

last_heartbeat_at.description: Recorded most recent heartbeat. A producer without a heartbeat channel does not record it.

stopped_at.description: Time the physical stop was verified, when recorded; null means the instance was not observed stopped.

stop_evidence.description: Instance-level physical stop evidence, when the producer recorded it.

External_model_instance_schema_json_Stop.description: Instance-level physical stop evidence: the process or container exited, its reserved resources were released, and the observation was verified. Lease and submit-intent cleanup evidence is execution-level, carries its own kinds, and is not reported here.

changed_fields.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointers for fields changed by the audited action.
Store field names only; never include before/after values, request
bodies, credentials, content, audio, feature vectors, or paths.

Unauthorized.description: Shared service credential required or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The deployment Host or Origin policy refused the request.

Conflict.description: Revision mismatch, idempotency conflict, or incompatible lifecycle transition.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Invalid binding, capacity, or qualification composition.

BindingListMethodNotAllowed.description: The model binding collection accepts GET for the list and POST for drafts.

ModelInstanceNotFound.description:
No recorded instance generation matches the request. Both misses use
404; `error.code` distinguishes them. `model_instance_unknown` means no
generation of the instance id is recorded. `model_instance_generation_unknown`
means the instance is recorded but the requested generation is not.

SharedServiceKey.description: Optional deployment-wide shared credential; not a user identity.
